evidence.test_name: R1: accepts exactly one stdin or request-file object through both public entrypoints
R2: validates the plain request object, identifier, and optional Version selector
R3: discovers unique Versions and selects an explicit Version without fallback
R4: returns the exact metadata success envelope with one item
R5: projects metadata through the public whitelist and derives lifecycle and capabilities
R6: sources Timestamp availability only from confirmed state-changing Activity timing
R7: exposes deterministic public ArtifactDescriptors and validated Activity relations only
R8: returns only the bounded confirmed Activity prefix in confirmationOrder
R9: applies the default page, exact page bounds, and finishedAt datetime filter
R10: binds opaque cursors to resource, selector, bounds, and confirmationOrder
R11: projects every ActivityItem component with exact public keys and reference filtering
R12: emits known-resource errors with stable public paths and no partial projection
R13: maps invalid JSON and public validation failures to the centralized error codes
R14: represents active, parked, derived-blocked, and finalized Versions as public lifecycle data
R15: reads Version 1 and Version 2 through the same public schema and exact Version identity
R16: leaves canonical files, runtime side effects, and Git state unchanged on success and failure
R17: preserves existing registry, help, status, config, and lifecycle behavior beside the query route
